Frequently Asked Questions

Is Group 8D being phased out?

Group 8D is a large legacy size increasingly replaced by Group 31 batteries, which deliver comparable CCA in a smaller, lighter package.

How heavy is a Group 8D battery?

Group 8D batteries typically weigh 55–75 kg (120–165 lb) depending on technology and capacity — confirm exact weight in the datasheet.
